definition: Action explicitly seeks to stop delay prohibit condition revoke or restrict construction operation or deployment
use_when: The objective and target are source-traceable
do_not_infer: Success project change or anti-U.S. actor identity
review_requirement: principal review of function and target

definition: Investigation damage recognition compensation disclosure review or attribution of responsibility
use_when: A formal or public accountability action/role is evidenced
do_not_infer: Constraint success remediation or policy change
review_requirement: principal review of function and intermediate output

definition: Measures or services reduce a specified harm without necessarily changing the underlying military presence
use_when: A concrete harm and mitigating measure are named
do_not_infer: Pro-base anti-base or acceptance of the underlying presence
review_requirement: principal review of function and harm target

definition: Services mutual aid fundraising distribution or care sustain personnel families or base-community life capacities
use_when: A service/resource relation and beneficiary population are evidenced
review_requirement: principal review of function and beneficiary scope

definition: Resources services referrals or relationship interfaces cross the boundary between base/military-family organizations and Okinawan local welfare education child medical social-welfare-council or NPO fields
use_when: Both boundary sides direction and the concrete cross-boundary resource/service/referral fact are source-traceable
do_not_infer: Political acceptance endorsement legitimation dependency influence continuity or garrison reproduction unless separately evidenced
review_requirement: principal review of boundary sides direction underlying fact and interpretation limit

definition: Explicit relationship-building/trust/acceptability strategy or evidenced public reception/effect concerning U.S. military presence
use_when: At least L1 evidence is present and mechanism_status states the achieved evidentiary level
do_not_infer: Legitimacy effect from charity service or official publicity alone
review_requirement: principal interpretation review; L2/L3 required for reception/effect wording

definition: One indivisible observation explicitly contains two or more function codes
use_when: The fact cannot be decomposed and component_function_codes are stated
review_requirement: principal review of components and indivisibility

definition: Observation is in scope but available material cannot support a function classification
do_not_infer: Neutrality apolitical status or no effect
review_requirement: may remain unreviewed candidate; publication only as gap

Source establishes that an action or service occurred
Official record establishes a procedural organizational or governance role
A judgment record vote report compensation or other formal output is evidenced

definition: Source establishes change in construction operation deployment or another prespecified outcome
do_not_infer: Causation by the actor without a design

definition: Recipient local institution or independent source records acceptance resistance or reinterpretation
Pattern is analytically plausible but not directly stated by evidence

Only the actor's origin links the observation to the United States

Direct charitable monetary transfer

do_not_infer: Disbursement or downstream allocation unless stated

definition: Payment under an official commission/contract mechanism

definition: Member contribution to an umbrella or association

definition: Named scholarship award or program transfer
